title: Individual and Uniform Eventual Positivity of Self-Adjoint Semigroups
summary: We construct a real self-adjoint semigroup on an $\ell^2$-space which is individually eventually strongly positive with respect to a strictly positive vector, but whose operators fail to be positive at arbitrarily large times. Moreover, the generator of this semigroup has compact resolvent. Consequently, individual and uniform eventual positivity are not equivalent for self-adjoint semigroups on $L^2$-spaces, even under the additional assumption that the generator has compact resolvent.
